name.value: Campbell River Art Gallery & Gift Shop

description.value: The Campbell River Art Gallery (CRAG) is an established public art gallery in downtown Campbell River showcasing rotating exhibitions by local, regional, and national artists alongside a permanent collection. The gallery also operates satellite campus spaces, educational programs, and an Art Hive, making it a significant cultural hub on Vancouver Island's cycling routes. A gift shop offering artist-consigned work is on site, providing a meaningful stop for cyclists interested in local art.
